roadmap.title: Tutorial and early service tasks
roadmap.description: Discard a cooked fish in the Tutorial, then start a restaurant and enter Practice Mode. Use quiet early days for the one-tile, patience and mess challenges.

roadmap.title: Unlock and serve every required recipe
roadmap.description: Gain experience from completed restaurant runs and work toward level 15. Start each required recipe and serve a customer. Play solo or host these restaurants. If an unlocked recipe is absent in Headquarters, enter and leave the Tutorial to refresh the selection.

roadmap.title: Collect equipment for the special tasks
roadmap.description: Buy the shoes, knife, conveyors and remote-service equipment as their blueprints appear. Use the Research Desk and Blueprint Cabinet to obtain a Grabber. Equipment goals can overlap with recipe runs.

roadmap.title: Set up the fire challenges
roadmap.description: Research a Danger Hob and obtain a Gas Safety Override. Keep fire experiments away from the equipment you need for service, and use spare appliances for the ten-appliance fire.

roadmap.title: Reach overtime milestones, then franchise
roadmap.description: Take a strong restaurant past the original Day 15 and keep the same run going to Overtime Day 15. If a service is about to fail, exit before game over and reload the day. After the overtime milestones, let the restaurant close and create a franchise.

achievements.description: Serve a steak to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a steak order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Steak} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 1}.
Cook meat on the hob until it matches the customer’s requested doneness. Put the steak on a plate and deliver the order.

achievements.description: Serve a stir fry to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a stir fry order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Stir Fry} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 15}.
Put raw rice in a @item{Wok} and cook the rice first.
Chop the carrot and/or broccoli shown in the order. Add one requested vegetable to the Wok and cook again. If both vegetables are requested, add the second and cook once more.
Transfer the finished stir fry to a plate and deliver the order.

achievements.description: Serve a pizza to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a pizza portion order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Pizza} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 3}.
Work flour into dough on a counter, then add oil to make a pizza base.
Process a tomato twice to make sauce, and chop cheese. Add the sauce and cheese to the base.
Cook the pizza, take a portion onto a plate, then deliver the customer’s order.

achievements.description: Serve a salad to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a salad order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Salad} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 2}.
Chop lettuce and any tomato shown in the order. Put the requested ingredients on a plate and deliver the salad.

achievements.description: Serve a pie to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a pie order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Pies} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 7}.
Work flour into dough, then work the dough into a @item{Pie Crust}. Add meat, cook the filled pie, then plate and deliver the order.

achievements.description: Serve a fish to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a fish order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Fish} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 9}.
Cook the blue or pink fish shown in the order. Put the cooked fish on a plate and deliver the order.

achievements.description: Serve a hotdog to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a hot dog order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Hot Dogs} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 11}.
Cook a hot dog, add a @item{Hot Dog Bun}, then plate and deliver the order.

achievements.description: Serve a breakfast to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a breakfast order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Breakfast} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 13}.
Work flour into dough, then bake the dough into bread.
Take a slice from the loaf and cook the slice into toast. Plate the toast and deliver the breakfast order.

achievements.description: Serve a burger to a customer
achievements.summary: Deliver a burger order to a restaurant customer.

steps.text: In Headquarters, select @mechanic{Burgers} and start a restaurant. The recipe unlocks at @mechanic{level 5}.
Cook a raw patty, add a @item{Burger Bun}, then plate the burger and deliver the order.

achievements.description: Complete a day when the restaurant has been on fire for more than 15 seconds
achievements.summary: Finish restaurant service after a fire has lasted longer than @mechanic{15 seconds}.

steps.text: Put a @item{Danger Hob} in a spare area away from your working kitchen. During service, leave food on the hob until the food burns and starts a fire.
Keep the fire burning for more than @mechanic{15 seconds} and finish serving the day’s customers.
steps.note: If the day ends without enough fire time, try again on a later day.

achievements.description: Complete a day with 10 appliances on fire at once
achievements.summary: End a service day with at least @mechanic{10 appliances} burning simultaneously.

steps.text: Away from your working kitchen, make a connected block of at least @mechanic{10 appliances}, including a @item{Danger Hob}. Spare counters can fill the block.
During service, burn food on that hob and let the fire spread through the block. Finish the day while at least ten appliances are burning.
steps.note: Burning appliances cannot be used. Keep your service equipment separate; retry on a later day if you finish before ten appliances catch fire.

achievements.description: Serve a customer with less than a second to spare
achievements.summary: Deliver a customer’s meal with less than @mechanic{one second} of food-waiting patience remaining.

steps.text: Prepare the requested meal and wait beside the customer’s table. Place the meal on the table when the food-waiting patience bar is almost empty.
steps.note: Serving too soon means trying another customer. If patience is about to expire, exit before game over and reload the day.

achievements.description: Complete a day with a mess on at least 10 tiles
achievements.summary: Finish a service day with at least @mechanic{10 floor tiles} covered in mess.

steps.text: Let cooking and dining dirty at least @mechanic{10 floor tiles}. Leave those tiles dirty and finish serving the day’s customers.

achievements.description: Set a customer on fire
achievements.summary: Ignite the chair occupied by a restaurant customer.

steps.text: Place a @item{Danger Hob} directly beside a customer chair, rather than beside the dining table.
During service, burn food on the hob. Leave the customer seated without serving their meal until the fire reaches the occupied chair.
steps.note: If the customer’s patience is about to run out before the chair catches fire, exit before game over and reload the day.

achievements.description: Cook something on a Danger Hob with an activated Gas Safety Override
achievements.summary: Cook food on a @item{Danger Hob} while a @item{Gas Safety Override} is active.

steps.text: Store a Hob blueprint in a Blueprint Cabinet beside a Research Desk. Research the blueprint during service; if the result is a Safety Hob, research that blueprint again on a later day to obtain a @item{Danger Hob}.
Purchase the researched hob and a @item{Gas Safety Override}. Set the Override beside the Danger Hob, with the outlet aimed at the hob.
Put food on the Danger Hob and hold Interact on the Override while the food cooks. Remove the cooked food before it burns.

achievements.description: Wear Trainers while holding a Sharp Knife
achievements.summary: Have @item{Trainers} equipped while carrying a @item{Sharp Knife}.

steps.text: Use a chopping recipe such as Salad, then buy @item{Trainers} and a @item{Sharp Knife} when their blueprints appear.
During service or Practice Mode, equip the Trainers and pick up the Sharp Knife so you have both at once.

achievements.description: Convey an item back to where it started
achievements.summary: Move an item by conveyor back onto the conveyor where the item began.

steps.text: Buy four @item{Conveyors}. Arrange them in a 2×2 square and rotate the arrows to form a continuous loop.
During service or Practice Mode, place an empty plate on a Conveyor and let the plate make a full circuit.

achievements.description: Activate Practice Mode during preparation time
achievements.summary: Start a restaurant practice session before opening for service.

steps.text: During restaurant preparation, activate the outdoor @mechanic{Practice Mode} spot.

achievements.description: Create a franchise
achievements.summary: Turn a restaurant into a franchise.

steps.text: Complete the original @mechanic{Day 15} and enter overtime. Keep this restaurant running until you have the overtime achievements you want.
steps.note: Before an early service reaches game over, exit the game and reload the restaurant to retry the day.

steps.text: After the restaurant closes during overtime, choose to create a @mechanic{franchise} and keep three cards. Do not scrap the entire restaurant for experience.

achievements.description: Reach Overtime Day 5
achievements.summary: Advance a restaurant to @mechanic{Overtime Day 5}.

steps.text: Complete the original @mechanic{15 days} to enter overtime. Keep the same restaurant running until Overtime Day 5 begins.
steps.note: Before a failed service reaches game over, exit the game and reload the restaurant to retry from the beginning of that day.

achievements.description: Reach Overtime Day 10
achievements.summary: Advance a restaurant to @mechanic{Overtime Day 10}.

steps.text: Continue the same restaurant through the days after Overtime Day 5 until Overtime Day 10 begins.
steps.note: Before a failed service reaches game over, exit the game and reload the restaurant to retry from the beginning of that day.

achievements.description: Reach Overtime Day 15
achievements.summary: Advance a restaurant to @mechanic{Overtime Day 15}.

guide.context: Batch meals such as Turkey and automated portioning can reduce the work during busy services. Choose added recipes only when their extra preparation is manageable.

steps.text: Continue the same restaurant after Overtime Day 10 until Overtime Day 15 begins.
steps.note: Before a failed service reaches game over, exit the game and reload the restaurant to retry from the beginning of that day.

achievements.description: Throw away a cooked fish in the tutorial
achievements.summary: Discard a cooked fish inside the Tutorial.

steps.text: Enter the @mechanic{Tutorial} beside the kitchen in Headquarters. Cook the fish, then drop the cooked fish into the bin.

achievements.description: Complete a day without anyone serving a customer directly
achievements.summary: Finish an entire service day with no player serving customers directly.

steps.text: Buy an @item{Ordering Terminal} and a @item{Grabber}. To obtain a Grabber, store a Conveyor blueprint in a Blueprint Cabinet beside a Research Desk and research the blueprint during service.
Use one active dining table with two chairs. Point the Grabber from a food counter toward the table so meals can travel from the counter to the customers.
Take orders through the Ordering Terminal. Put finished meals on the counter and let the Grabber deliver every meal until the day ends.
steps.note: No player should place meals on the serving Grabber or table. After a manual delivery, retry on a later day or exit before game over and reload the current day.

achievements.description: Complete a day without any player leaving the tile they started on
achievements.summary: Finish a service day with every player staying on their original starting tile.

steps.text: On the first day of a solo Steak restaurant, arrange the fridge, hob, plates, sink, counter and a dining table around one empty tile. Keep the customer chairs accessible from outside this workspace.
Stand on that empty tile before starting service. Turn to cook, serve and wash dishes without stepping away until service ends.
steps.note: If you step off the tile, exit before game over and reload the restaurant to retry the day.

achievements.description: Have the first group to arrive still be waiting to order when the day ends
achievements.summary: Keep the day’s first arriving group waiting to order until the day timer reaches closing.

steps.text: Leave the first group’s order untaken until the day timer reaches closing. Serve other tables while keeping an eye on that first group’s patience.
steps.note: Taking their order early loses the attempt. Exit before game over and reload the day, or try again on a later day.

steps.text: After the timer reaches closing, take the first group’s order and serve them. Finish any remaining service.
